extension.summary: View your Immich photos and videos in Kodi
extension.description: Browse the timeline, On this day, people and pets, places, albums and favourites of a self-hosted Immich server, or search by description. Watch them as a slideshow that crossfades and slowly pans and zooms across each photo, with photo details at the press of Info. View only: nothing is changed on the server.
extension.disclaimer: Requires an Immich server that you own or have an account on. Not affiliated with the Immich project.
extension.news: v0.2.5 - Photos glide between screen pixels on Kodi builds that support it, edges included - Photos shown again load at full resolution, not from Kodi 22's smaller cached copy v0.2.4 - Ken Burns is subtler: a gentle zoom, 105% by default, that never enlarges past the original - Photos that do not fill the screen sit on the blurred backdrop; wide panoramas pan slowly instead - Motion starts quickly and settles slowly - Each photo waits for the next to arrive, so slow connections no longer fade to black - Zoom can be set from 101% to 110% v0.2.3 - Music keeps playing when a slideshow starts - The API key is hidden while you type it - An address without http:// or https:// uses https, except on the local network - Clearer message when the API key lacks a permission - A dropped or stalled connection shows an error instead of failing v0.2.2 - Rotated photos show upright with full resolution on v0.2.1 - Fix Kodi freezing for minutes when a video stops v0.2.0 - The API key no longer shows up in Kodi's debug log or image cache - Pause and resume videos in the slideshow - Date, place and count share one row under each photo v0.1.1 - Pan and zoom runs at its proper speed on skins such as Confluence ZEITGEIST v0.1.0: initial release - timeline, On this day, people, places, albums, favourites, search, and a pan and zoom slideshow
